settings.location_mode.label: Location
settings.location_mode.description: Which place the weather is for. 'City' looks up the name below. 'Automatic' guesses a place from your IP address: that sends your IP address to an external service (ipwho.is) and is only approximate, it can be a different city than yours. 'Coordinates' uses the latitude and longitude below.
settings.city.label: City
settings.city.description: Name of the place, in Dutch or English, for example Emmen or The Hague. The best match is used; the panel shows which place was found.
settings.country.label: Country code
settings.country.description: Two-letter country code such as NL or BE to pick the right place when names repeat. Leave empty to search all countries.
settings.latitude.label: Latitude
settings.latitude.description: Used in coordinates mode for the nearest station and the rain outlook.
settings.longitude.label: Longitude
settings.longitude.description: Used in coordinates mode for the nearest station and the rain outlook.
settings.station_id.label: Station ID
settings.station_id.description: Buienradar measuring station ID (e.g. 6279 = Hoogeveen). 0 picks the station nearest to the place.
settings.page_query.label: Link parameters
settings.page_query.description: Added after the ? of the Buienradar link, for example which radar layer and time window the page opens with. Leave empty for the plain page of the city.
settings.page_url.label: Page URL (override)
settings.page_url.description: If set, the link at the bottom of the panel opens this address instead of the page built from the city.
settings.refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
settings.refresh_minutes.description: How often to fetch new data from Buienradar.
settings.wind_unit.label: Wind unit
settings.wind_unit.description: Unit of the wind speed in the bar tooltip and in the panel.
settings.bar_text.label: Bar text
settings.bar_text.description: What this bar widget prints next to the weather icon.
settings.bar_text.option.temperature_rai: Temperature, ☂ when rain is expected in the next 2 hours
